CustomField.description: Formula to link rounds to their master round. This is the weekday round or the AM dispatch of Pret Rounds.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Weekday_Round__c)), CASESAFEID(Weekday_Round__c), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Master_Round__c)), CASESAFEID(Master_Round__c), CASESAFEID(Id) ) )
CustomField.label: Master Round (Formula)
